purpose: Repeat the exact R2 publication protocol on two new fresh servers after repairing and unit-testing compact frozen-oracle qualification.

repair_boundary.r2_status: excluded failed harness postprocessor; not reused as an R3 attempt
repair_boundary.repair: publication mode requires 64 compact token-ID SHA-256 rows while pilot mode requires 64 raw token-ID arrays
unit_tests: raw pilot oracle accepted and compacted
compact frozen oracle accepted for publication qualification
raw oracle rejected as a substitute for the frozen compact oracle

server_profile.excluded_warmup: one distinct 128-prompt-token, 128-output-token request before the measured ladder

measurement.required_output_gate: 128 complete raw token IDs per measured response, zero cached prompt tokens, and no generated token digest equal to a frozen sequential oracle from another base task
measurement.sequential_identity: reported but not required because TP2 greedy output may vary with batch shape
measurement.required_throughput_stability_gate: relative range between the two attempts at every point <=10%
measurement.required_latency_stability_gate: relative range between the two attempts for TTFT p50/p95 and end-to-end p50/p95 at every point <=15%
measurement.queue_boundary: c1-c4 are active-slot measurements; c8-c64 include service queueing because max_num_seqs=4

publication.throughput: median of two exact fresh-server aggregate tok/s values per concurrency
publication.latency: median of the two per-attempt p50/p95 TTFT and end-to-end latency values per concurrency
